Pb-Pb 5.02 TeV: ALICE PRL 116 (2016) 132302 arXiv:1602.01119 (HEPData ins1419244), |eta|<0.8, 0.2<pT<5 GeV/c, v2{2,|deta|>1}, v3{2}, v4{2}. PbPb_2760._note: 5.02 TeV values divided by the measured increases (3.0%, 4.3%, 10.2%)

pPb_5020._note: ALICE PRC 90 (2014) 054901 arXiv:1406.2474 HEPData ins1300038: v2{2,|deta|>1.4} = 0.066, v3{2} = 0.0166 at N_ch ~ 113 (|eta|<1, ~top 0.8%). The 0-5% value 0.060 is interpolated towards the low-multiplicity 0.057, which contains non-flow [approximate]. v4 not measured here (set to 0).
